qualification.rule: PROVEN_REAL requires the real OS mechanism, host, hardware or network. A proxy result is never written up as a production acceptance; where only part of a criterion can be proven here, the rest stays NOT_YET_PROVEN until it runs for real.
qualification.stage_1_session0_ipc_identity: COMPLETE for everything provable without the install: implemented (ADR-0028), independently security-reviewed (one Critical in the fix - the shipped companion silently ran developer trust - fixed), independently verified with every check mutation-tested, two of my own over-claims corrected in place. 120 agent tests.
qualification.stage_2_service_install: READY - waiting on the owner's single UAC action; scripts/install-device-service.ps1 then scripts/verify-device-service.ps1.
qualification.stages_3_to_11: PREPARED where possible: owner-credential bootstrap, local DPAPI secret entry, CI (Windows agent + recovery supervisor + secret hygiene), OpenTofu for a Hetzner host with no public application port. Real browser, real voice and real mobile qualification follow their owner actions.

owner_actions_pending: Before first GitHub push: run 'gh auth login' once (browser OAuth), then a private repo can be created and CI activated.
Cloud deployment (any time): approve Tailscale install (UAC) + sign in; approve Hetzner account/billing/API key. Local milestones are complete without these.

M4 Voice real-audio layer: provision voice-provider API keys (PAGENTOS_VOICE_*) and record owner speech samples for real speaker enrollment + blind A/B benchmark; plugs into the built interfaces without code changes.

M8 asset enrollment: enroll the real hosts/networks/devices you authorize, with evidence and scope (the registry and its API are built and tested; only the owner's real authorization records are missing).

M9 on-device verification (OPEN): the server contract is proven, but real push delivery to a locked phone and microphone/realtime capture under iOS/Android backgrounding need a physical device; distribution beyond a local build additionally needs developer-account/store actions.

OWNER CREDENTIAL (M9): the first real deployment must run POST /v1/identity/bootstrap once from the machine itself and store the returned credential in a password manager. It is shown exactly once; recovery is 'python -m app.identity.recover' on the host, never through the API.

CURRENT ACTION - Windows Service install (one UAC): UNBLOCKED. M1 security finding #1 (Session-0 pipe identity) is closed by ADR-0028, security-reviewed and independently verified. Run scripts/install-device-service.ps1 elevated, sign out and in, then scripts/verify-device-service.ps1 and send the output.
Owner-browser enrollment (M2 production path): harden enrollment registry file ACL (M2 finding #6) + owner approval flow before real-browser attach.

CLOSED by M9 (ADR-0027) - the API authentication/identity layer standing since M0. Every endpoint outside the five documented unauthenticated ones now requires an owner session, enforced by a route-table sweep over the live dependency graph, so (a) speaker verification, (b) memory owner-authority mutations, (c) self-healing ingest/pipeline, (d) the evolution endpoints and (e) the security asset-enrollment endpoints are all authenticated. Remaining within this area, and smaller than the original gate: no per-route rate limiting beyond credential-exchange throttling, and scope narrowing is enforced but not yet used by any route.

HARD GATE - runtime confinement before enabling any I/O-capable generated operation or a non-deterministic skill generator (M7 review verdict (d)): the permission model is enforcing at generation/evaluation/review time but advisory at dispatch.
Recommended, non-blocking: move Docker Desktop disk image location from C: to E: (C: has ~24 GB free).

quality_gate.scope: Full gate + -E2E 12/12: secret hygiene, ruff, API 1323 unit + 94 integration, recovery-supervisor 25 tests + ruff, browser 75 unit + 39 e2e, Windows agent 91 xUnit, alembic 0010, M1 Notepad E2E with restart recovery, web build. Exit 0.

notes: M9 complete: owner identity (ADR-0027) plus the native-mobile server surface. Bearer sessions minted from a file-backed credential root deliberately OUTSIDE the database, hash-only and constant-time, with TTL/idle timeout, refresh rotation, panic revoke-all, host-side recovery and a token-free append-only audit. This closes the API-authentication hard gate carried since M0: every M4-M8 endpoint is authenticated and the five-endpoint unauthenticated surface is enforced by a test that walks the live route table and dependency graph, so a new unprotected route fails the suite. On top of it: push registrations and an artifact-ready announcer that delivers before it records delivery (one transaction, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), notification inbox, share/export, narration cursor across the mobile lifecycle, device-bound sessions that die with the device, a headless reference client driving the whole mobile contract, and web-shell owner sign-in. Independent verification: five of six acceptance bullets proven outright against a live server (including an adversarial auth-bypass sweep and a live device-revocation run); real push delivery to a phone and mic/realtime under OS backgrounding are proven-by-proxy and stay owner actions. Security review: 2 Medium + 3 Low, all fixed - deliver-then-stamp ordering, scope narrowing made structural (bare require_owner_session refuses a scoped session), loopback guards fail closed, revocation ordering, and a corrupt identity root that refuses cleanly and can never be overwritten by bootstrap. Also fixed, from the verifier: dev-Postgres connection exhaustion under E2E tests that hard-kill worker subprocesses - graceful stop where the kill is not the point, plus max_connections and server-side TCP keepalives in the dev compose; a full integration run now leaves zero idle backends. Next: M10 Optimization, which the roadmap gates on real use - so the useful work before it is the owner-action batch below (bootstrap the owner credential, gh auth, Tailscale/Hetzner, asset enrollment, a physical phone).
